test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six friends, Prerna, Priyanka, Rahul, Vishal, Tushar and Shruti, are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. Priyanka is sitting to the immediate left of Tushar. Vishal is sitting to the immediate left of Rahul. Prerna is second to the right of Vishal. Prerna is sitting between Rahul and Shruti. Who is sitting between Prerna and Vishal?
solution:
Given:

Six friends sitting around a circle facing the centre: Prerna, Priyanka, Rahul, Vishal, Tushar and Shruti

1) Vishal is sitting to the immediate left of Rahul.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e799e7eed202b2cfb49497ad4cbe0a74591b23aa77ed0921b6353e8f32292b40.png] 

2) Prerna is second to the right of Vishal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6deabcb41f6314061d2043d5ae4100f0665693bbcb77e672688835b09939c322.png] 

3) Prerna is sitting between Rahul and Shruti.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fc9ff29cab62650d9e884cb67301bc3fd222657a8a37a9761850f77af506d76.png] 

4) Priyanka is sitting to the immediate left of Tushar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c151eaa47519082a602e61ec6a0a62984088dbdf5abd3c43a367f6eeec7d5e3.png] 

Thus, “Rahul” is sitting between Prerna and Vishal.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Rahul".**
